summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Bulk User Invites feature. All 4 pytest cases and full UI E2E flow passed. Verified counter, role dropdown, results table (invited/duplicate/skipped/invalid), copy buttons, list refresh, invited user login with temp password reaches /clients, correct role applied, and superuser-only permissions (both nav visibility and API 403 for admin).
critical_code_review_comments: UserManagement.js is 575 lines — approaching split threshold; consider extracting BulkInviteDialog into its own component.
Backend _generate_temp_password uses secrets.token_urlsafe(9) => 12 chars, OK but consider enforcing minimum complexity policy or forcing password change on first login for invited users.

Frontend calls window.location.origin-derived API URL rather than process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — worth verifying it complies with the environment rule (found via handleBulkInvite POST using ${API}); acceptable if API var is derived from env.
seed_data_creation: During tests created transient users test_bi_* and test_ui_*. All deleted post-test; only the 4 seed users remain (super, admin, manager, marketer).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bulk-invite feature verified end-to-end. Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_bulk_invite.py — reusable regression. Cleanup of test users happens via module-scoped fixture but relies on collecting IDs; if tests are re-ordered, ensure test_bulk_invite_mixed_input runs before test_invited_user_can_login_and_role_applied (they use pytest attribute passing).
